$comment: Chat attachment delivery golden, generated from the Web production path (UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 in apps/app/lib/core/attachments/__tests__/delivery-golden.contract.test.ts). Each case: input.text is the user text; input.attachments are files as picked (content = raw extracted text, or gen = {line, count, repeat?}: count lines, each line = `line` with {n} replaced by the 1-based line number, repeated `repeat` times, joined by "\n"; fileBytes = original file size, defaults to the UTF-8 length of the raw text; originalBytes = size of the kept original binary, used for native upload and judged on that raw byte length against the route cap; extractionErrorCode = extraction failed with no text); input.line is the Web transport name (attachment-transport.ts); input.model holds the model fields that drive delivery (nativeFileMimes, pdfNativeDefault, attachmentExtraction overrides). The raw text is truncated at import with the model limits (500 lines / 204800 UTF-8 bytes by default, a single over-long line is cut at a UTF-8 character boundary). expect.native / expect.text list attachment ids uploaded natively / injected as text blocks; expect.blocked lists files the injector cannot fit (too_many_files / total_cap_exceeded): the request is not sent, and body is then the injector output with the blocked files left out. body is the final user message text sent to the model: user text plus injected blocks (xml-v1 or markdown-v1 per route), image parts replaced by the route image placeholder when the route declares one, text parts joined by a blank line; native file and image blocks are not part of body. Bodies over 4096 bytes are stored as bodySha256 (hex of UTF-8) + bodyBytes. systemSuffix is appended to the system prompt (after a blank line) when the user turn has attachments.
